items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: With Al Hurt, we recorded right on the job at Dance Pier 600... That's the only ones that I'm on with Al and Pete. The volume one and two of Audio Fidelity... And a verve, long playing with Pete and Alhurt.

ctx.x: By the way, where did you record with Al Hurt? What time?

With Al Hurt, we recorded right on the job at Dance Pier 600. And we recorded two... Let's see. The first Audio Fidelity we recorded was Volume 1 on Audio Fidelity. Sunday was our hardest day. On a Sunday, we used to work 4 to 8, and then 9 to 3. Now, on Sunday, we played the 4 to 8 deal in the afternoon. And then we played 9 to 3.
